overview: Smart Meter Tamper Investigation addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in power and utilities operations. The first proof of value uses meter voltage patterns, seals and historical consumption. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is confirmed tamper cases per inspection, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: meter voltage patterns, seals and historical consumption; define confirmed tamper cases per inspection and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Grid Operations Director / Chief Asset Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
